summary: Sprint 6a J-7 smoke test — backend + frontend. Built /app/backend/tests/test_sprint6a_smoke.py covering public catalog, auth (register+cookie login+/auth/me), 4 admin endpoints, guest checkout via POST /api/checkout (+ idempotency), admin cancel via PUT /api/admin/orders/{id}/status, affiliate /join validation, and login rate limit. Result: 13 pass / 1 skip / 1 fail out of 15. Two production-relevant bugs surfaced: (P0) email-render NameError blocked EVERY checkout — fixed in this iteration; (P0) login rate-limit trivially bypassable in the K8s+Cloudflare deployment because TRUSTED_PROXIES is empty and _client_ip() returns rotating pod-egress IPs — reported to main agent, NOT fixed (needs infra decision). Frontend smoke via Playwright: homepage renders, age gate accepts, /catalog shows 36 products, /login form present, admin login → /account, /ops-portal-fn7k2q dashboard renders with real data (325 orders, 8580 CAD revenue).

critical.issue: 500 Internal Server Error on every successful checkout. server.py:12839 assigns `html = _nova_email_shell(...)` which makes `html` local to _email_render; the closure `sub()` at L12826 references `html.escape` (the stdlib module) → NameError. Every guest/user checkout that triggers order confirmation email raises 500 AFTER the order row was written (order likely persisted but response is 500 → customer sees a failure and may retry, breaking idempotency UX). FIXED in this iteration by renaming the local to `rendered_html` and inner body-html to `body_html_shell`.

Declared limit is 5/15min per (client_ip, email). In current deployment `TRUSTED_PROXIES` is empty in backend/.env, so server.py:_is_trusted_proxy_peer returns False and `_client_ip` falls back to the K8s ingress peer host. Observed 3 distinct peers (10.208.135.194 / 10.208.135.198 / 23.81.12.55) during 15 back-to-back wrong-password logins → per-IP counters never reach 5, no 429 issued. Same problem affects every _rate_limit(_client_ip, ...) call: /register (5/hr), /admin_gate (5/hr), /magic_verify, /notify_stock, and _shared_mutation_rate_limit middleware. Also means audit/log IPs are wrong. FIX: set TRUSTED_PROXIES in backend/.env to the K8s ingress CIDR (e.g. 10.208.0.0/16) + Cloudflare CIDRs so cf-connecting-ip is honored.

minor.issue: Not registered (404). Review request expected 200 with site settings, but no route matches. No frontend consumer found — likely a spec artefact. Confirm whether the endpoint is planned or the spec is stale.
Only DELETE is registered; no GET-by-id. Not critical (list endpoint carries the same data) but noted in test.

issues: CSP violations on every page for the Cloudflare beacon (static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js) and two inline scripts injected by Emergent preview harness. Prod-facing CSP is `script-src 'self'` — either add the beacon origin + specific hashes, or accept the console noise. Not a functional bug in the preview env.

action_items: P0 — Rate-limit bypass: set TRUSTED_PROXIES env var (K8s ingress CIDR + Cloudflare) so _client_ip returns the real client IP; without this, brute-force protection is effectively off on launch day.
P1 — Verify /api/site/settings requirement: either implement the endpoint or update the spec/tests. No frontend consumer today.
P2 — Consider normalising all rate-limit keys to use cf-connecting-ip directly when running behind Cloudflare, with strict validation, so the throttle survives infra churn.
P2 — Login response for unverified email is 403; confirm that's the desired UX. Frontend should show the FR/EN verify-email message clearly.
Post-fix retest: re-run `pytest tests/test_sprint6a_smoke.py -v -n 0` after TRUSTED_PROXIES is set; the rate-limit test should switch to PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:12821 _email_render — local var `html` shadows the stdlib `html` module used by the nested `sub()` closure. FIXED. Any function that both imports a stdlib name and shadows it locally should be linted; add a pyflakes/ruff rule (F823 / A005) to CI to catch these before launch.

server.py:936 _client_ip — silently trusts request.client.host when TRUSTED_PROXIES is empty. Combined with _rate_limit's per-IP keying, this yields a false sense of protection. Consider making TRUSTED_PROXIES required (fail-fast on startup) OR default to `cf-connecting-ip` when the CF-Ray header is present (Cloudflare guarantee).

server.py:970 _rate_limit_distributed — good use of Mongo TTL-safe upsert with atomic $inc + $setOnInsert. Reject on Mongo failure (503) is defensive but blocks all mutating traffic if Mongo has a transient hiccup; consider a short retry.

server.py:12850 send_template_email — currently doesn't wrap the render/send in try/except. When _email_render raises, checkout 500s AFTER the order is persisted (side-effects half-applied). Consider swallowing render/send exceptions and only logging, so a template bug never blocks a paid checkout.

admin_orders.py:52 PUT /admin/orders/{id}/status takes query params for payment_status/fulfillment_status, not a JSON body. Frontend must match; consider migrating to a body for consistency with the rest of the admin API.

rca_of_the_issue: P0#1 (checkout 500): `def _email_render(...)` at server.py:12821 defines a nested `sub()` closure using `html.escape` (stdlib). Later at L12839 the function assigns `html = _nova_email_shell(...)`. Because Python resolves scope statically per function, that later assignment makes `html` local everywhere in _email_render — including inside the closure — so `html.escape` inside sub() fails with `NameError: cannot access free variable 'html'`. This bubbles up to /api/checkout after the order row is persisted. Fix = rename the local to a non-shadowing name. P0#2 (rate-limit bypass): rate limiter keys on `_client_ip(request)` which trusts CF/XFF headers ONLY if the peer IP matches TRUSTED_PROXIES. Env is empty, so the peer is the K8s ingress pod IP which rotates between requests (observed 10.208.135.194, .198, 23.81.12.55). Each rotation resets the (ip, email) counter so 5-limit never trips. Fix = populate TRUSTED_PROXIES with the ingress subnet + Cloudflare CIDRs, so cf-connecting-ip is honored.
